name: TOTP Enrollment Success
summary: An authenticated user enrolls a time-based one-time password authenticator, confirms possession with a valid generated code, enables MFA for the current durable identity, and receives recovery codes for later account access.
finalOutcome: TOTP is enabled for the current durable identity, the authenticator secret is stored securely, and a fresh set of recovery codes has been issued to the user.

sourceReferences.note: BeginTotpEnrollmentAsync and ConfirmTotpEnrollmentAsync implement authenticator enrollment and confirmation.
